name: Number Guessing Game
prompt: Generate a random integer from 1 through 100. Read guesses until the player guesses correctly, printing 'Too high!' or 'Too low!' after each incorrect guess. Then print 'Correct! You guessed it in N attempts.' Count every guess as an attempt. Do not print input prompts; output only feedback lines.

test_cases.name: high then low then correct
test_cases.expected_output:
Too high!
Too low!
Correct! You guessed it in 3 attempts.

test_cases.name: correct on first guess
test_cases.expected_output: Correct! You guessed it in 1 attempts.
